verdict.rationale: Godot imports files placed in the project folder automatically, supports custom import plugins that treat custom resources as first-class, and lets users change import parameters on several assets at once; EditorScript and headless mode allow scripted editor automation. Import presets and post-import hooks are not explicitly documented in the pack, and there is no hands-on evidence of a headless batch-import pipeline. missing for 10: documented import presets/defaults, explicit post-import hook scripts for processing incoming assets, evidence of headless/CI batch reimport, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a technical artist, asset import is automatable — import hooks, presets, and pipeline scripts process incoming assets without hand-clicking each one

citations.quote: Godot will automatically import these files internally and keep the imported resources hidden in a res://.godot/imported/ folder.
An import plugin is a special type of editor tool that allows custom resources to be imported by Godot and be treated as first-class resources.
Changing the import parameters of several assets at the same time is also possible.
Scripts extending this class and implementing its _run() method can be executed from the Script Editor's File > Run menu option
